name: elfarida-ice-deploy
description: Static bilingual marketing site for Elfarida Ice Industrial Refrigeration, deployed on Cloudflare Pages.
author: Elfarida Ice

scripts.dev: npm run build && wrangler pages dev dist
scripts.deploy: npm run build && wrangler pages deploy dist --project-name elfarida-ice
scripts.lint: eslint functions workers js/index.js js/lead-tracking-lib.js js/conversion-kit.js js/maintenance-estimator.js tests scripts/stamp-assets.mjs
scripts.format: prettier --check functions/**/*.js workers/**/*.js js/index.js js/lead-tracking-lib.js tests/**/*.mjs
scripts.format:write: prettier --write functions/**/*.js workers/**/*.js js/index.js js/lead-tracking-lib.js tests/**/*.mjs
